insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: Bariatric Surgery and Hospice Care: 24-month waiting period each. SI up to Rs 1 Cr for entrants up to 65; above 65 capped at Rs 50L.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Room: 1% of SI per day or Rs 20,000/day, whichever lower
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Proportionate deductions for higher room categories (except hospitals without differential billing).

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day-care procedures up to Sum Insured

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Excludes listed common conditions (asthma, hypertension, diabetes, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush_coverage.limit_text: AYUSH in-patient and day-care up to SI (excluding Yoga & Naturopathy)

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Over and above Limit of Coverage up to SI; for Donor's expenses only
organ_donor_expenses.notes: Includes donor complications requiring redo surgery / ICU.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road: actual; Air ambulance: Rs 2,50,000/hosp, max Rs 5,00,000/policy year

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Automatic Restoration once at 100% of SI
restoration_benefit.notes: Triggers on partial or full utilization; usable for all subsequent claims in policy period; per-claim cap = Limit of Coverage.

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Rs 3,000 (SI 10L) up to Rs 10,000 (Floater SI 75L-1Cr) per claim-free year

room_rent_capping: 1% of SI per day or Rs 20,000/day whichever lower
copayment_trigger_notes: 20% mandatory copay if entry age > 65 years (including renewals).

disease_wise_sub_limits.cataract: Per eye Rs 50,000 (SI 10/20/30L) / Rs 60,000 (SI 50L+); per policy year Rs 80,000 / Rs 1,00,000
disease_wise_sub_limits.rehabilitation_pain_management: Up to 10% of SI per policy year
disease_wise_sub_limits.hospice_care: 10% of SI or Rs 5L (once in lifetime)
disease_wise_sub_limits.home_care_treatment: 10% of SI or Rs 5L per policy year

permanent_exclusions: Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care (Code Excl 05)
Obesity/Weight Control (Code Excl 06, except Bariatric Surgery benefit)
notable_exclusions_summary: PED 24-month waiting plus standard IRDAI permanent exclusions. Bariatric covered only on cashless basis with clinical-protocol compliance. Diagnostic-only admissions and rest cure excluded.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via 14,000+ network hospitals; reimbursement via Star Health TPA/insurer claim portal.
